evidence_scope: Allow-listed reconstruction of the corrected 24-task native-Codex baseline launch and outcome summary.

launch.historical_runner_path: scripts/run_codex_harness_baseline.py (retained privately; not distributed in this repository)
launch.task_manifest: the 24 public task identifiers listed in outcomes.csv

reconstruction_basis: The retained launch event invokes the surviving runner on the exact public 24-task manifest with one repeat, a 30-turn soft cap, no injected skill, and the corrected compatibility verifier image.
The launch omits model and reasoning-effort overrides; the runner writes a clean run-scoped Codex configuration whose defaults are gpt-5.5 and high reasoning effort.
The retained completion readout reports 24 of 24 attempts completed, 12 of 24 passed, and no Codex runner failure or timeout; outcomes.csv preserves the task-level binary results.
terminology: high is the formal baseline runner reasoning-effort setting; the manuscript describes it parenthetically as the heavy-reasoning setting used for this experiment. Settings of the surrounding authoring session are not baseline settings.
limitations: The raw authoring-session record is excluded because it contains unrelated private conversation and machine-local paths.
The original attempt directory and complete per-attempt Codex event streams were not retained.
The exact Codex CLI build is not independently recoverable from the public artifact.
The verifier image used a mutable latest tag, and no immutable image digest was retained.
The runner SHA-256 was computed retrospectively from the separately retained source; it was not embedded in the launch manifest.
This record supports configuration and aggregate-outcome provenance, but it does not make the contextual Codex baseline fully independently reproducible.
